app.name: Sigo
app.disclaimer: Sigo is not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting a new exercise program.

today.title: Today
today.skippedOther: We skipped {{pattern}} today: we couldn't find an option that works for you.
today.empty: We couldn't find safe exercises for you today. Check your equipment in Profile and your pain areas.
today.doneBody: Great job. Rest and see you tomorrow.

pain.title: Pain
pain.intro: Mark where it hurts. Sigo avoids or softens the exercises that load that area.
pain.mapHint: Tap an area on the figure to add or change it.
pain.empty: You have no areas marked. Great!
pain.removeBody: Sigo will stop protecting this area in your exercises.

profile.title: Profile
profile.seatedOnlyHint: Helpful if you feel unsteady standing.
profile.activityHint: Changing it starts all your exercises at that level.
profile.activityDoctor: Based on your health questions, talk to your doctor before raising the level.
profile.floorOkHint: Only if you can get down to the floor and back up without help.

reason.seatedVersion: It's the seated version: same work, less load.
reason.gentlerVersion: It's a gentler version of the same movement.
reason.avoidsArea: This one keeps the load off the area that hurts.
reason.similarMovement: It works the same part of the body without loading the area that hurts.
reason.mobility: For now, a gentle movement to loosen up.

swap.title: Try this one instead
swap.restBody: We couldn't find another exercise that protects that area today. Rest, then we'll go on to the next one.

activity.strength: I do strength training or sports 2 or more times a week

bodyMap.caption: The figure is seen from behind: your left side is on the left.

doctorNotice.title: Please talk to your doctor before starting
doctorNotice.body: You can keep going, it's your decision. We'll start with gentle, seated exercises, and you can change that later in Profile.

painNotice.title: Please talk to your doctor before starting
painNotice.body: Very strong or sharp pain is worth showing to a doctor. You can keep going: we'll avoid exercises that load that area.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sigo
welcome.body: Gentle exercise at home that adapts to your discomfort. All you need is a sturdy chair.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body: If something hurts a lot, stop and rest. If you feel chest pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, stop and call 911.

screening.title: A few quick questions
screening.intro: Take your time. This helps us keep you safe.

activity.title: How active are you?
activity.hint: This way we start at your pace. Sigo adjusts it over time.

floor.title: Can you get down to the floor and back up without help?
floor.hint: If you say yes, we'll sometimes suggest exercises on the floor, on a towel or a mat.

painWhere.title: Where does it hurt?
painWhere.hint: Tap the figure or pick from the list. You can mark more than one area.

equipment.title: What do you have at home?
equipment.hint: Check what you have. A sturdy chair is enough to start.

ready.title: You're all set, {{name}}!
ready.body: Today's workout is waiting for you. Go at your own pace.

tips.water: Keep water nearby and take sips.
tips.chair: Use a sturdy chair without wheels, placed against a wall.
tips.redFlags: If you feel chest pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, stop and call 911.
tips.pain: Mild discomfort is OK. If the pain is sharp or very strong, stop.
tips.breathe: Keep breathing during every exercise. Don't hold your breath.

workout.exitTitle: Are you sure you want to stop?
workout.exitBody: We'll save what you already did.
workout.tooEasyHint: Offers you a slightly harder exercise

rest.title: Rest
rest.ratingHint: It's optional. It helps us adjust your workout.

harder.title: Try a harder one?
harder.topTitle: You're at the highest level of this exercise
harder.topBody: Do it slower and more controlled: that makes it harder too.

hurt.title: Where does it hurt?
hurt.sharpHint: Like a stab or a sudden jab.

safety.title: Stop and rest
safety.body: Sit down and breathe calmly. Don't keep going with this exercise.
safety.redFlags: If you have chest pain, feel dizzy or short of breath, call 911.
safety.okHint: You rest, then go on to the next exercise
